Summary
Image     lab, Ubuntu 24.04 amd64
User      student, passwordless sudo
System    UTC, en_US.UTF-8, systemd on
Sources   Ubuntu's archive only
Packages  none

Not in Ubuntu's noble archive:
  ninja-buld  nearest: ninja-build
  docker-ce
The recipe has no other source that could provide them, so build will
stop at "Unable to locate package" unless one is added.

This is what frostroot.toml will say:
╭──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ # frostroot recipe: the image you want. Edit it, then run: frostroot build                                           │
│ #                                                                                                                    │
│ # Versions do not belong here. frostroot build writes the exact version of                                           │
│ # every installed package to frostroot.lock; commit both files.                                                      │
│                                                                                                                      │
│ [image]                                                                                                              │
│ name = "lab"  # file name of the tarball and name of the WSL distro                                                  │
│ release = "24.04"                                                                                                    │
│ arch = "amd64"  # the only architecture in v1                                                                        │
│                                                                                                                      │
│ [user]                                                                                                               │
│ name = "student"                                                                                                     │
│ sudo = true  # passwordless sudo: this is a lab image, not a hardened server                                         │
│                                                                                                                      │
│ [wsl]                                                                                                                │
│ systemd = true                                                                                                       │
